notes.title: First look at In the Abyss of Dream
notes.notes:
One year after the resounding success of the crowdfunding campaign for October Nightmares, Studio Chien d’Or is proud to unveil the first images of its prelude, In the Abyss of Dream. This new game lays the foundation for the universe, characters, and themes that will take center stage in October Nightmares, while also exploring a dark chapter of Québec’s history: the Grande Noirceur (the Great Darkness).

Through the eyes of orphans, silent victims of this era, In the Abyss of Dream delves into a pivotal moment in Québec’s past. 

The game will come out on June 17th 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346520/In_the_Abyss_of_Dream__Dans_labme_du_rve/

notes.title: The Whispering Valley now on mobile!

It’s a perfect way to relive the experience from the comfort of your bed or on the subway!

notes.title: Mac version now available!
notes.notes:
I have some great news today. You can now play The Whispering Valley on Mac! Sorry it took me so long to release it. Since I still don't have a Mac, I couldn't test the build so I had to wait on someone lending me one. I did my tests on a Macbook Air and it ran well, so there shouldn't be any issues on more performing computers.  But if you encounter any problems, please let me know!

Olivier

notes.title: Help us reach 50 reviews (we are almost there!)
notes.notes:
Last post I wrote about this worked well. Because of your help, we saw a 30% increase. I am so please that we are at 36 reviews and that most of them are positive! But to get our "very positive" rating, we need to reach the 50 reviews mark.

[b]To achieve this, we need your support! If you enjoyed The Whispering Valley, please consider leaving a review.[/b] It could be a very short one if you don't have much time. This would help us tremendously in making our next point & click horror game!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Road to 50 reviews (we are halfway there!)
notes.notes:
Hello!

As you might know, reaching the 50 reviews mark is quite important. Instead of having a "positive" rating, we would get a "very positive" one. It might not sound as much, but it is! It would give us way more visibility on Steam!

[b]To achieve this, we need your support! If you enjoyed The Whispering Valley, please consider leaving a review.[/b] It could be a very short one if you don't have much time. This would help us tremendously in making our next point & click horror game!

I am also taking this opportunity to tell you how happy I am about the game reception and sales. Thank you to all of you who bought and/or share the game. I am excited for what's next!

Thank you!
Olivier

notes.title: Quickfix: Doctor house loading issue
notes.notes:
Another day another quickifx. You can't say I am slow to react to your bug reports!

So this update is fixing an issue related to loading a save file in the doctor's house. Short story: if you saved & quit while next to the examination table on the second floor, you would appear outside of the map on load. This should be fixed now.

Also I took the opportunity to remove a few trees next to the hunter's house so it is easier to see.

notes.title: Quickfix: Puzzles readability
notes.notes: Third quickfix patch since the release and that one isn't related to a bug but to the readability of two puzzles: one in the inn and one in the presbytery. Without any spoilers, I know some of you had trouble solving this puzzle so I made a few changes to a certain texture so it is more eye-catchy. Also I fixed a lightning problem in the presbytery so you can look around more easily.

notes.title: Quickfix #2
notes.notes:
For the next few days, I'll continue pushing quickfix updates as you report bugs that I can easily fix. So on this second quickfix...

Fixed: Problem loading the doctor house scene after saving near the examination table and loading back into the game.

notes.title: Quickfix #1
notes.notes:
Quickfix patch for fixing three bugs 

1) [i]If you save a game while in close view (looking at something with a static cam), go to the main menu and load the game, your camera will be stuck. You need to re-launch the game. [/i] That's now fixed.

2) [i]Unable to load the game after saving and exiting the game inside the presbytery.[/i] That's also fixed.

3) I also made some changes to the scene loading system to lower the chances of encountering a problem.

notes.title: The Whispering Valley is now available!
notes.notes:
After 3 years of hard work, The Whispering Valley is finally available on Steam! We want to thank everyone who supported this project that we cared so much about!

Explore a remote village and solve complex puzzles in The Whispering Valley, a folk horror point & click game. Delve into guilt and depression to investigate the village's deepest secret.

If you are on Mac, no worries, we are working to release a Mac version in the upcoming weeks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512390/The_Whispering_Valley__La_valle_qui_murmure/

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
Some exciting news today!

After 3 years of development, The Whispering Valley will release on November 30th on Windows. The Mac version will be available in the following weeks.

Explore a sinister village and solve complex puzzles in The Whispering Valley, a story-driven point & click game. Delve into the horror of guilt and depression to investigate the village's deepest secret.

Province of Quebec, 1896. Hidden in the hollow of a valley, the village of Sainte-Monique-Des-Monts conceals a secret that weighs heavily on the community. The village is left abandoned. Those who remain can only wait. But something else torments the inhabitants. A shadow prowls around the village. Some saw it, others heard it. They heard it whisper.

notes.title: The Whispering Valley crowdfunding campaign
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

You will be happy to know that since last year, the development of The Whispering Valley hasn't stopped! The game is still on its way for late 2022. But we will need help for the last stretch. This is why we launched yesterday a new crowdfunding campaign.

The campaign is on La Ruche, which is a local crowdfunding platform. It will last 45 days. After the first day, we already reached 10%. Btw, you can have your own in-game tombstone :)

Give what you can (and if you can) and [url=https://twitter.com/Olivier_Leclair/status/1513912317179842569]share around[/url]!

notes.title: The Whisperer coming out in 2 weeks
notes.notes:
[b]The Whisperer, prelude to The Whispering Valley, is coming out December 16th on Windows.
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697940/The_Whisperer/

Lower Canada, 1813. A trading post in a remote valley is found abandoned. The two winterers who inhabited it have disappeared. Robert, a voyageur of the North West Company, is tasked in investigating their disappearance. To find the truth, he will have to face horrors of all kinds...

Explore an abandoned trading post and solve a complex puzzle to investigate the terrible secret it holds. The Whisperer (Le Murmureur) is a short story-driven point & click game set in Lower Canada at the beginning of the 19th century.

Inspired by games such as Scratches and The Dark Eye, The Whisperer is an ode to the classic horror point & click subgenre. You will find the old school adventure features that we all love: puzzle solving, exploring, inventory, using and combining objects.

The Whisperer is a standalone game, but it also serves as a prelude to The Whispering Valley (2022).

Add it to your Steam wishlist!

[previewyoutube=Utlxdl7DD7k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Whisperer, a prelude to The Whispering Valley
notes.notes:
I have important news for you!

So I have been planning a side-project for some time now. It was initially meant to be a post-release DLC to The Whispering Valley, but with the unsuccessful Kickstarter campaign, I changed my mind... I want you to have something to sink your teeth in while you wait for The Whispering Valley.

The Whisperer is a short horror point & click game. It takes place in Lower Canada, 1813. Explore an abandoned trading post and solve a complex puzzle to investigate the terrible secret it holds. 

This is not a prologue to The Whispering Valley, but a standalone prelude. You won't have to play TW to get what's going on in TWV. It is entirely optional!

The game won't be free, but it will be cheap. My price point is "large latté in Montréal", so around 6$ CAD.

Add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697940/The_Whisperer/
